datasets.title: Haiti - Rumors and Feedback on Hurricane Matthew - 2016/2017
datasets.description: The data was collected in the most affected areas by Internews staff and partners organizations to look at the aftermath of Hurricane Matthew and the perceptions that beneficiaries had of the response overall.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/rumors-and-feedback-in-haiti-hirricane-matthew-nov-2016-feb-2017]

lineage.description: Internews staff and partner organizations conducted direct observational surveys and collected anecdotal feedback from beneficiaries in the most affected areas of Haiti following Hurricane Matthew (2016) to document community perceptions of the humanitarian response and post-event conditions.

sources.name: Internews
sources.description: Direct observational and anecdotal data collected by Internews staff and partner organizations from beneficiaries in Hurricane Matthew-affected areas regarding response perceptions and aftermath conditions.

resources.title: Haiti_Data_Final.xlsx
resources.description: This data was collected in Haiti after Hurricane Matthew from November 2016 to February 2017 by the Internews Humanitarian System. The data includes feedback and rumors.

losses.description: Community perceptions and feedback on Hurricane Matthew response and aftermath impacts
